sources.quote: Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 60 Splinters of Wrath enhances Force of Will to deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage.
E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage), R sphere count (r_spheres).
A resource (internal index 12) consumed by specific actions ... stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.

independent_computation.step_2_which_abilities_can_show_100: Only W at rank 5 (100) and R at any rank (100). [S2, S4]
independent_computation.step_3_which_abilities_can_show_50: Only E at any rank (50 flat) and Q at rank 3 (50). At the maxed ranks a level-18 golden scenario uses (Q5/W5/E5/R3) the only 50 available is E. [S1, S3]
independent_computation.step_4_rank_indexing_ruled_out: No single Syndra ability can move from 100 to 50 by a rank change: E is flat 50 across all five ranks and R is flat 100 across all three; W's range bottoms out at 60 and Q's tops out at 60. Therefore the leaf did not change because a rank index changed - the ability occupying cast_timeline[3] changed identity. Old 100 = R (or W5); new 50 = E.

step_5_direction_of_the_shift_is_the_dec.premise: The scenario name carries the splinter count 60. The cached wiki text sets the Q charge threshold at 40 Splinters (S5) and the W true-damage threshold at 60 (S6), so at 60 splinters Syndra has a stocked second Dark Sphere charge available - the audit note confirms this is modeled as a distinct 'Q2' cast slot (S7), and the ammo atom confirms Dark Sphere is a stocked-charge resource where each stocked cast is a separate, separately-paid cast (S8).
step_5_direction_of_the_shift_is_the_dec.no_charge_timeline: casts in cast order Q, W, E, R -> costs 60, 100, 50, 100; index 3 = R = 100
step_5_direction_of_the_shift_is_the_dec.charge_honored_timeline: the stocked charge inserts one extra early Dark Sphere cast: Q, Q2, W, E (, R) -> costs 60, 60, 100, 50; index 3 = E = 50
step_5_direction_of_the_shift_is_the_dec.conclusion: Inserting the sourced second Q charge shifts every later slot right by one, moving index 3 from the 100-mana slot (R/W5) to the 50-mana slot (E). The observed 100 -> 50 has exactly that sign. Dropping or ignoring the charge would move index 3 the other way (50 -> 100). Since the wiki text grants the charge at >= 40 splinters and this scenario is at 60, the timeline that pays 50 at index 3 is the game-accurate one. The same conclusion holds under the alternative reading that the fix simply made the timeline pay each cast's own cost under a non-default cast order (S9, 'resolved greedily by cast order'): the cost that belongs to the fourth cast is that cast's own sourced cost, and 50 is a real Syndra cost (E) while under the old behavior index 3 kept the default order's fourth cost (R = 100).

independent_computation.step_6_result: cast_timeline[3].resource_cost = 50 mana (E - Scatter the Weak, 50 at every rank per S3). 100.0 is not attributable to any ability that can stand fourth once the 40-splinter Dark Sphere charge is honored at splinters = 60.

limitations: The scenario definition (option set for 'syndra_custom_order_60', including the literal custom cast order and ability ranks) lives in scripts/ and tests/, which runbook R-18/R-19 forbids this oracle from reading. The identity of the fourth cast was therefore reconstructed from the cached wiki cost table plus the splinter thresholds, not read off the scenario.
docs/math-foundations.md contains no closed-form for resource cost; it constrains only the cast schedule (S9). The cost values themselves are pure lookups from data/champions.json.

Both 50 and 100 are legitimate Syndra mana costs in isolation; the verdict rests on step 5 (the direction of the slot shift under the sourced 40-splinter Dark Sphere charge), not on either value being intrinsically impossible.
